id: title:andehen:allow detaching a shared metric with a colliding uuid

review.posthog_relevance: Preservation of inline metric identity and ordering in the Experiments backend, preventing accidental removal of shared UUIDs during saved metric detachment.
review.reason: The change P1.F1.H1 introduces a specific exclusion of inline metric UUIDs from the removal set, preventing a potential data loss or ordering corruption when shared UUIDs exist between saved and inline metrics. P1.F2.H1 provides a regression test asserting this shared identity preservation. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for the Experiments feature,
review.uncertainty: The exact production impact depends on the frequency of shared UUID scenarios and the criticality of inline metric ordering, which are not demonstrated by the code alone. No evidence of actual incidents or adoption is provided.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds inline UUID extraction and exclusion from removal sets; the removal calculation no longer removes UUIDs belonging to inline metrics.
observations.posthog_connection: In the experiments backend, when an experiment is updated and saved metrics are removed, this change prevents the system from incorrectly removing the UUID of an inline metric that shares the same UUID as a detached saved metric, preserving the inline metric's ordering entry.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameterized test asserting that detaching a saved metric while retaining its inline copy preserves the shared UUID in the ordering and the inline list.
observations.code_quote: assert [m["uuid"] for m in getattr(updated, field)] == [shared_uuid]
observations.posthog_connection: This test validates the behavior described in P1.F1.H1, ensuring that PostHog users relying on shared UUIDs between saved and inline metrics do not lose the inline metric's identity or ordering after a detach operation.
